lines:
sequenceDiagram
participant Worker as Workflow Worker
participant Broker as Invocation Broker
participant Auth as Authority Engine
participant Commit as Canonical Committer
participant API as Desktop API
actor UI as UI Projection Gateway
participant Secret as Secret Lease Broker
participant Host as Capability Host
Worker->>Broker: InvocationProposalV1(run node attempt invocationId authorityRef)
Broker->>Commit: commit InvocationProposedV1
Commit-->>Broker: durable proposal head
Broker->>Auth: EvaluateInvocationV1(proposal, frozen manifest)
Auth-->>Broker: AuthorityDecisionV1
alt decision is denied
  Broker->>Commit: commit InvocationDeniedV1 with reason codes
  Commit-->>Broker: durable outcome
  Broker-->>Worker: CapabilityOutcomeV1 denied
else decision requires approval
  Broker->>Commit: commit ApprovalRequestedV1 with nonce expiry and exact scope
  Commit-->>API: committed approval event
  API-->>UI: approval projection
  UI->>API: ApprovalResponseV1(commandId, nonce, expectedVersion)
  API->>Broker: ResolveInvocationApprovalV1
  Broker->>Auth: resolve nonce response and frozen manifest
  Auth-->>Broker: ApprovalResolvedV1
  alt rejected expired or stale
    Broker->>Commit: commit ApprovalRejectedV1
    Commit-->>Broker: durable outcome
    Broker-->>Worker: CapabilityOutcomeV1 rejected
  else explicitly approved
    Broker->>Commit: atomic ApprovalGranted + InvocationAuthorized + secret-free DispatchOutbox
    Commit-->>Broker: durable authorization head and outboxId
  end
else decision is permitted
  Broker->>Commit: atomic InvocationAuthorizedV1 + secret-free DispatchOutbox
  Commit-->>Broker: durable authorization head and outboxId
end
opt decision is permitted or explicitly approved
  Broker->>Secret: IssueInvocationLeaseV1(decisionId invocationId audience ttl)
  Secret-->>Broker: SecretLeaseHandleV1
  Broker->>Host: ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1 with stable invocationId and lease handles
  alt host accepts and returns definite result
    Host-->>Broker: Accepted then CapabilityOutcomeV1
    Broker->>Commit: commit dispatch delivered plus semantic result usage artifacts
    Commit-->>Broker: durable settled outcome
    Broker->>Secret: revoke invocation leases
    Broker-->>Worker: committed CapabilityOutcomeV1
  else delivery or result is ambiguous and effect may have begun
    Broker->>Commit: commit OutcomeUncertainV1 and no-resend marker
    Commit-->>Broker: durable uncertain outcome
    Broker->>Secret: revoke invocation leases
    Broker-->>Worker: uncertain outcome. Workflow or user regains control
  else definitely not started
    Host-->>Broker: DefiniteNotStartedV1
    Broker->>Commit: commit retry-eligible failure
    Broker->>Secret: revoke invocation leases
    Broker-->>Worker: failure under frozen retry policy
  end
end
Note over Broker,Host: Ambiguous resend is allowed only with the same invocationId when declared idempotent and host deduplication is guaranteed
Note over Commit,Worker: The worker receives only committed outcomes and can propose but cannot authorize or commit

data.title: Capability Authority, Approval, Dispatch, and Uncertain Outcome
